experiment: R4.2, first half: production after the fuel inventory is emptied
why: The Phase 5 demonstration removed fuel at tick 4050, recorded the drill still `working` with zero fuel, and refuelled 90 ticks later. Nothing measured whether the line ever stopped, so its recovery claim rests on an outage that may not have happened.

method.disruption: get_fuel_inventory():clear() on both machines; entity.energy untouched
method.advance: env.advance, in decision_ticks chunks, tick-aligned through the typed path
method.stored_energy_source: world.truth(); the observation carries neither field
